messages:
marta_cs: Quick kickoff note — Keystone pilot kickoff tomorrow 10:00am PT (calendar sent). They want a 6-week pilot of Dedicated for a fraud-detection assistant. Main asks: low latency, predictable cost, deterministic rollback. Join: https://meet.example.com/keystone-pilot :calendar:

marta_cs: Context: Keystone will route live scoring (streaming) and batch backfills. Legal has an SOC audit on their roadmap; procurement could slow renewal if pilot overruns.

jon_sre: tagging eng for sizing. Can someone share expected peak QPS and avg seq length? I need numbers to model GPU pool sizing and autoscale headroom. Also: will they use streaming endpoints or non-streaming?

sam_se: I'll run onboarding workshops. Proposed cadence:
- Week 0: API keys, network allowlist, credentials
- Week 1: integration + smoke tests
- Week 2: model tuning + eval prompts
- Week 3: staging ramp + perf tuning
- Week 4-5: prod ramp + handover
I will produce a runbook + recordings.

alex_pm: Draft success criteria (product):
- 99th perc latency <= 300ms for non-batched scoring
- End-to-end error rate < 0.5%
- Inference cost per 1k requests within budget (finance TBD)
- Quality: model F1 within 3% of baseline on eval set
- Rollback: ability to revert to prior model within 5 minutes

marta_cs: Renewal risk: procurement + SOC could delay contract signature. Marking medium risk if pilot completion slips beyond week 6. Action: CS + Sales to map procurement milestones and lock PO path.

jon_sre: For sizing I can start with a conservative estimate: assume 200 concurrent streams, avg seq=512 tokens, burst factor 2. I'll put a calc in the shared drive. If anyone has telemetry from their test harness drop it here. Also note: KV cache warmup could matter for first-minute tail latency.

sam_se: They confirmed streaming via API. I'll include two 90-min hands-on sessions: eng integration and security review. I'll ask them to share a sanitized sample payload and expected latency SLOs.

alex_pm: Action items (owners + short due dates):
- jon_sre: sizing doc + config recommendations (due Fri EOD)
- sam_se: workshop agenda + onboarding runbook (due Mon)
- marta_cs: confirm weekly sync cadence with customer + procurement milestones (due Tue)
- alex_pm: finalize success metrics, share eval prompts and dataset (due Mon)
React with :thumbsup: when you accept.

jon_sre: Accepted :thumbsup: Will upload sizing spreadsheet and initial GPU pool plan.

deploybot: Reminder: Keystone pilot kickoff meeting scheduled for 2026-03-24 10:00 PT — https://meet.example.com/keystone-pilot

marta_cs: Thanks — I'll take notes and publish a kickoff recap + decisions doc post-meeting. Anything else to add before we meet?
